training: Original balanced synthetic seven-segment masks with symmetric bottom-right decimal dot and bloom augmentation; no factory/video images used for training
scope: Leading 1/2/7 and decimal-adjacent 2/7 verification, requiring seven-segment 7 geometry (top bar, right stem, no 2 e/g strokes) and two OCR views agreeing on remaining digits
validation_note: Factory photos and video crops were used as independent evaluations/regressions, not training inputs; no claim of factory-wide accuracy.
